title.narrative: Skill Up! Strengthening Skills Development, Creating Future Perspectives for Tajik Youth

description.narrative: Impact:The economic stability and decent income generation of vulnerable young people have improved through gainful / profitable employment or self-employment, resulting in increased food and nutrition security.Outcome:Young vulnerable people use the acquired (labour) market relevant competencies and the provided access to necessary resources & labour market linkages to secure (self-) employment opportunities

Staff of service providers (ca. 70 women and men); VET service providers (Management of 7 TVET centres); National actors (ca. 9 experts); Youth group (opened up to 45 yrs) (750, out of them min. 30% female), among: Vulnerable people, min. 75 (10% of total youth group beneficiaries)

The project targets the micro, medium and macro levelsMacro level: The Committee for vocational education under the president's office will be support to establish sustainably expert groups for regular curriculum/ module updates meeting the actual market needs.Medium level: The governmental TVET service providers will be supported to implement the updated inclusive modules, ensuring a qualitative service with the quality monitoring system established by the project. Income generating business models for the financial sustainability of the TVET service providers will be developed.Micro level: Youth people (people with disabilities, left behind/ single women, labor migration affected families) benefit from improved services of the TVET system and will graduate.
